description: Unified knowledge base for DEM cathode packing of our ASSB dataset. Combines (A) effective-modulus calibration rationale, (B) bimodal size-ratio packing theory, (C) the empirical regime map observed across 60 cases, (D) the coupling between plastic deformation (E_eff) and geometric packing, and (E) scaling-law evolution v29 → v30 (v1.1: outlier patterns + correction-term candidates). Cross-references contact_mechanics_db.json (Tabor/Hertz/Holm formalism).

scaling_law_evolution.description: Running log of the FORM X scaling-law refinement. Each section below records one version with its motivation, formula, fit statistics, remaining outliers, and insights that feed the next version.

v29_FINAL.formula: σ = C_blend(τ) · C_pf(p) · G(τ,p) · C_gb(sigmoid) × σ_grain × √(φ−0.20) × CN^(3/2) × cov^(2/5) × f_p^3

fit_stats_60_cases.band_20pct: 58/60 with fitted params; 53/60 with module defaults (0.966)

v29_FINAL.strength: Captures particulate monodisperse series (D0.5–D3, S) essentially within ±15% across all AM:SE ratios (62:38, 72:28, 82:18). Bottleneck-regime cases with hemisphere cap activation 10–17% are ALSO inliers — v29 handles plastic-dominated packing natively.

A_thin_85:15_overshoot.signature: σ_actual very low (0.02–0.04), τ_Dij high (2.0–2.4), v29 systematically OVERSHOOTS by +37 to +55%
A_thin_85:15_overshoot.physical_cause_hypothesis: At SE-lean 85:15 in thin electrode, SE network fragments faster than v29's φ^0.5 · CN^1.5 · f_p^3 kernel predicts — the actual σ collapses more sharply near percolation threshold than the scaling law allows.

B_thin_80:20_undershoot.signature: σ_actual moderate (0.15–0.19), τ_Dij 1.9–2.0, v29 UNDERSHOOTS by −16 to −29%
B_thin_80:20_undershoot.physical_cause_hypothesis: At SE-richer 80:20 in thin electrode, the 'direct boundary-to-boundary SE pathway' boosts σ above the bulk-like prediction. v29's τ-only treatment cannot capture the absolute-thickness effect.

C_real_PSD_overshoot.criterion: 'real' in case name AND thick > 100 μm
C_real_PSD_overshoot.physical_cause_hypothesis: Log-normal particle-size distribution (vs monodisperse) creates fine-particle tails that break some ionic paths. v29 fitted on monodisperse / bimodal-sharp distributions over-predicts σ when PSD is broad.

v29_FINAL.key_insight_1_direction_flip: Clusters A and B both occupy thin-electrode regime but have OPPOSITE error direction — boundary effect amplifies σ at moderate SE (80:20) but degrades it at low SE (85:15). v30 correction term must capture this via thin × (φ − φ_ref) interaction, NOT a simple thin-only multiplier.
v29_FINAL.key_insight_2_physics_cap_decoupled: Pearson r(|err|, geom_cap_%) = +0.10 → Physics-mode hemisphere-cap activation is NOT a predictor of v29 fit error. Bottleneck cases (particulate_10/11 with geom 15–17%) are fit within ±7%. Physics mode and scaling-law fit operate on orthogonal axes.
v29_FINAL.key_insight_3_particulate_immune: All 10 particulate_* cases (D0.5/D1/D2/D2_E/S × 3 AM:SE) fit within ±15%. This is the v29 comfort zone — monodisperse compositions over full AM:SE range.

scaling_law_evolution._naming_note: v30 / v30b-e / v31 were already used in prior exploration (see git log). Next free slot is v32. Future refits continue as v33, v34, ...

v32_in_progress.motivation: Close the 7 outliers of v29 in a SINGLE unified formula — no per-regime model switching. User directive (Apr 2026): exhaustive fitting of all available parameters before considering a 2-model approach.
v32_in_progress.naming_rationale: v30–v31 were used in earlier β_ps phase-split experiments (reverted). v32 is the next free slot.
v32_in_progress.approach: σ_v32 = σ_v29 × exp(Σ_i γ_i · feature_i). Multiplicative in linear σ, additive in log σ. Gammas fit by joint OLS + LOOCV-validated.
v32_in_progress.w_thin_definition: w_thin = exp(−T/T_char), T_char = 30 μm. Smooth transition, 1 at T→0, ~0.04 at T=100 μm.
v32_in_progress.pending_execution: scripts/v32_exhaustive_refit.py → ranks all single, pair, and triple combinations by LOOCV; greedy extension to k=4 and beyond.

suffix_meaning.AMP: All-Primary  — every AM is the LARGE radius class (r_AM_P, typically 5–6 μm)
suffix_meaning.AMS: All-Secondary — every AM is the SMALL radius class (r_AM_S, typically 2 μm)
suffix_meaning.(no suffix): bimodal mix of AM_P + AM_S (P:S ratio per meta.ps_ratio)
suffix_meaning._S1 / _S2 / _S3: SE-size strategy variant within one family (S1 = baseline, higher index = larger SE)
suffix_meaning._real: realistic particle-size distribution (log-normal or experimental PSD), not monodisperse

particulate_series_map.description: The particulate_N series sweeps SE particle size (D) and AM:SE composition. N correlates with SE size AND composition via the mapping below. Verified by porosity fingerprinting against the user's own SE-size plot (Apr 2026).

effective_modulus_block.description: Why DEM simulation uses E_eff = 1.35 GPa instead of E_real ≈ 24 GPa (LPSCl)
effective_modulus_block.calibration_target: porosity at target compaction pressure (linear regression against experimental pellet)
effective_modulus_block.key_consequence: δ_sim / δ_real ≈ (E_real/E_eff)^(2/3) ≈ 6.9× inflation of overlap; DEM-reported force is correspondingly scaled by E_eff and is NOT used downstream in our analysis — we read only δ (geometry-invariant) and recompute F_real with E_real in Physics mode.

bimodal_packing_theory_block.description: Classical size-ratio effect on packing fraction — controls D0.5 / D1 / D2 behaviour

size_ratio_effects.1:6 (D0.5): Small SE fits tetrahedral/octahedral gaps; geometric packing dominates
size_ratio_effects.1:3 (D1): Marginal — SE can still fit gaps but less efficiently
size_ratio_effects.1:1.5 (D2): Similar-size regime — bimodal packing theory predicts ~30% void geometrically; observed much lower because plastic flow takes over

geometric_regime.mechanism: SE fills AM interstices geometrically; plastic deformation minor
geometric_regime.porosity_vs_AM_trend: DECREASING (62:38 → 82:18) in small-SE cases due to SE self-packing — see se_self_packing_inversion below
geometric_regime.ionic_transport: sieve regime — wide, uniform contacts; σ_ionic high and stable

transition_boundary_D1_sweet_spot.description: D1 (r_SE/r_AM ≈ 1:3) sits exactly at the boundary between geometric and plastic regimes — neither mechanism is fully dominant. This is WHY D1 porosity is the most sensitive to composition changes in the dataset.
transition_boundary_D1_sweet_spot.key_finding: D1 is the ONE variant where Yu–Standish bimodal packing theory applies undiluted: SE excess above the theoretical optimum fraction leads to self-packing clusters; SE deficit leads to interstitial under-fill. No plastic compensation bridges the gap.

observed_deviations.D1_at_62:38_(38%_SE): 10 vol-pt excess → self-packing cluster → porosity 21.2% (highest in D1 row)
observed_deviations.D1_at_72:28_(28%_SE): match to optimum → porosity 17.2% (closer to ideal)
observed_deviations.D1_at_82:18_(18%_SE): 10 vol-pt deficit → incomplete gap fill → porosity 16.1% (still above ideal)

contrast_with_neighbours.D0.5_dilution_effect: Smaller SE 0.5 μm tolerates excess — can fit into higher-order interstices, so self-packing voids are smaller
contrast_with_neighbours.D2_plastic_compensation: Similar-size SE 2 μm triggers mutual plastic deformation at r_ratio 1:1.5 — any geometric deficit is 'filled' by plastic flow, masking the composition effect on porosity

transition_boundary_D1_sweet_spot.why_this_matters: D1's strong porosity swing (21.2% → 16.1%) is textbook evidence that we have captured a clean bimodal packing transition. Reviewers who doubt our packing model should be shown the D1 column — it is the one case where DEM output reproduces classical packing theory without plastic contamination.

signature.porosity: 5–10% at SE-rich, rising to 15–20% at AM-rich (INCREASING trend)

plastic_dominated_regime.mechanism: Similar-size particles cannot geometrically fit — plastic flow under E_eff compensates by letting particles inter-penetrate; apparent porosity is artificially low because V_overlap reduces counted volume
plastic_dominated_regime.porosity_vs_AM_trend: INCREASING (expected) — more AM and less SE at 82:18 means more geometric voids that plastic can't close
plastic_dominated_regime.ionic_transport: bottleneck regime — extreme-overlap contacts dominate R_constr; hemisphere cap activates; τ_Lap_eff >> τ_Dij

transition_regime.signature: mixed geometric + plastic — porosity monotonically rising; geom cap 4–8%; Δσ_physics 10–20%

three_regime_cheat_sheet.D0.5 (r_ratio 1:6): PURE GEOMETRIC  — small SE fits everything; porosity insensitive to composition
three_regime_cheat_sheet.D1 (r_ratio 1:3): BOUNDARY       — Yu-Standish textbook regime; porosity maximally sensitive (21% → 16%)
three_regime_cheat_sheet.D2 (r_ratio 1:1.5): PLASTIC        — E_eff-driven densification masks geometric deficit; porosity 6% at SE-rich
three_regime_cheat_sheet.D2_Dif_E: PLASTIC+       — same size ratio but softer E → even deeper plastic regime, max bottleneck

se_self_packing_inversion.description: Why D0.5 and S (small-SE series) show INVERTED porosity trend vs AM content
se_self_packing_inversion.observation: D0.5/S porosity DECREASES as AM:SE moves 62:38 → 82:18, opposite to D1/D2

mechanism.at_SE_rich_62:38: Small SE supplied in excess of AM interstitial demand → excess SE forms its own loose-packed cluster with SE-SE voids → inflates total porosity
mechanism.at_AM_rich_82:18: SE supply matches interstitial demand exactly → optimal filling → minimal voids
mechanism.turning_point: Depends on r_SE/r_AM — smaller ratio shifts optimum toward AM-rich side (because less SE is needed to fill gaps)

porosity_sigma_decoupling.description: Key finding: porosity and ionic conductivity are NOT monotonically related — SE particle size controls the coupling strength

d0_5_case_study.interpretation: High porosity + excellent σ. Small SE forms continuous thin-layer paths between AM surfaces; individual pore voids don't disrupt ionic connectivity.

d2_case_study.interpretation: Ultra-low porosity + still-high σ. Plastic-dominated compact structure creates many extreme-overlap contacts (p50 δ/R*=0.34, geom cap 13.6%) but redundant network topology keeps σ robust.

porosity_sigma_decoupling.general_law: σ_ionic correlates with (a) number of continuous SE pathways, NOT (b) total void volume. Small-SE cases maximize (a) even at high porosity; similar-size cases achieve compactness via (b) but pay in bottleneck resistance.

defense_narrative_catalogue.description: Ready-to-use one-liners for paper Methods / Discussion / Reviewer response
defense_narrative_catalogue.why_E_eff_is_valid: DEM simulations calibrate E_eff against experimental porosity at target pressure, folding plastic + rate-dependent contact effects into a single reduced stiffness (Cundall–Strack 1979). Because our downstream analysis uses only the geometric overlap δ and recomputes F_real with literature E_real, the E_eff choice does not propagate into reported contact areas or conductivities.
defense_narrative_catalogue.why_D2_porosity_is_6_percent: In D2 (r_SE/r_AM ≈ 1:1.5), classical bimodal packing theory predicts ~30% void geometrically. The observed 6.6% at 62:38 composition is attained through extensive plastic deformation: similar-size particles inter-penetrate under the 300 MPa target pressure, reducing apparent porosity without changing sphere count. The signature is p50 δ/R* = 0.34, with 13.6% of contacts bound by the hemisphere cap — evidence that plastic flow, not geometric rearrangement, is the densification mechanism.
defense_narrative_catalogue.why_D0_5_inverts: D0.5 (r_SE/r_AM ≈ 1:6) exhibits the inverse porosity-composition trend because excess small SE at SE-rich compositions forms a loose self-packed domain with SE-SE voids, inflating the measured porosity. Shifting to AM-rich composition (82:18) reduces SE count to match interstitial demand, recovering classical bimodal packing efficiency.
defense_narrative_catalogue.why_physics_mode_matters_only_in_bottlen: Across 60 cases, Physics mode correction is small (Δσ ≲ 5%) in the sieve regime (liggghts_lb ≥ 20%, r_SE/r_AM small), where the LIGGGHTS-reported contact area already encodes the E_eff-calibrated plastic footprint. Physics mode delivers its main value in bottleneck cases (geom cap ≥ 10%), where Tabor A diverges unphysically at large δ and only the hemisphere cap 2πR_min² keeps A_plastic realistic. This places Physics mode in a well-defined sensitivity-upper-bound role rather than a rival primary estimator.
